nodes.label: .`setUserId loads notifications and starts realtime subscription`()
.`setUserId does not load notifications when userId is null`()
.`loadNotifications sets refreshing flag when isRefresh is true`()
.`startRealtimeSubscription adds new notification at beginning of list`()
.`markAllAsRead successfully marks all notifications as read`()
.`markAllAsRead does nothing when userId is not set`()
